name: dev-cms
description: Dev CMS — host-agnostic authoring shell for file-backed content collections (dev-mode route)

scripts.build: bun run --filter @cms/astro-demo-simple build && bun run --filter @cms/astro-demo build
scripts.check: bun run --filter @cms/core check && bun run --filter @cms/authoring check && bun run --filter @cms/astro check && bun run --filter @cms/astro-demo-simple check && bun run --filter @cms/astro-demo check
scripts.check:allowlist: bun run --filter @cms/core check:allowlist && bun run --filter @cms/authoring check:layers && bun run --filter @cms/authoring check:allowlist
